Sandbox_DelRoads_TilesPerBag_tooltip: How many road tiles one bag of cement and one bag of gravel mend.
Sandbox_DelRoads_RepairLastsDays_tooltip: After about this many game days (give or take a quarter) a mended tile cracks again.
Sandbox_DelRoads_RequireOrder_tooltip: On: staff mend only inside an open work order of their own City Hall. Off: any road, orders only show the mayor's plan. Admins are never limited.
Sandbox_DelRoads_RepairTime_tooltip: Length of the timed action, in action ticks (vanilla plastering a wall is 100).
